verdict.rationale: The evidence documents serverless functions, event-triggered webhooks and customer subscription plans. None of these is a documented way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows, such as cron or scheduled functions. Webhooks fire on model events, which is event-driven rather than a recurring schedule. Subscriptions are recurring customer billing, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
